_comment: Single source of truth for the industry benchmarks that anchor pre-audit opportunity sizing and 2 of the 5 score dimensions. Refresh quarterly via WebSearch and bump `refreshed`. Every value MUST carry a source + source_date so the report can cite it and a prospect cannot discredit an uncited number.

meta_dtc_roas.label: Meta DTC ROAS
meta_dtc_roas.note: Avg return on ad spend, direct-to-consumer

meta_cpl.label: Meta CPL
meta_cpl.note: Cost per lead — ~60% cheaper than Google Ads ($70.11)

ad_survival_60d_pct.label: Ad survival >60d
ad_survival_60d_pct.note: Only ~11.3% of ads run past 60 days — longevity signals quality
ad_survival_60d_pct.source: Meta Ad Library longevity analysis (internal, public ads)
